# SCP-3008: The Infinite IKEA

> SCP-3008: The Infinite IKEA is a free multiplayer first-person survival horror game that runs in the web browser, based on the SCP Foundation entry SCP-3008, "A Perfectly Normal, Regular Old IKEA." You are trapped in an endless, procedurally generated IKEA: by day its faceless staff wander aimlessly, and at night they turn hostile and hunt you down.

- What it is: an open-source browser game (fan game, CC BY-SA 3.0 source material by Mortos)
- Features: infinite chunk-based procedural IKEA interior, day/night cycle, faceless SCP-3008-2 staff, survivor settlements with dialogue, weapons and flashlight, minimap, real-time multiplayer with chat, mobile touch controls
- Stack: React, TypeScript, Three.js (react-three-fiber), Zustand, Vite client; Node.js, Express, Socket.io server
- Play it: https://scp-3008.vercel.app
- Source: https://github.com/SimonSaysGiveMeSmile/SCP3008

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/SimonSaysGiveMeSmile/SCP3008/blob/main/README.md): overview, features, controls, setup and deployment
- [Client entry point](https://github.com/SimonSaysGiveMeSmile/SCP3008/blob/main/client/src/App.tsx): the React app that mounts the 3D scene, HUD, minimap and dialogue
- [World generation](https://github.com/SimonSaysGiveMeSmile/SCP3008/blob/main/client/src/utils/worldGen.ts): chunk-based procedural IKEA layout
- [Multiplayer server](https://github.com/SimonSaysGiveMeSmile/SCP3008/blob/main/server/src/index.ts): Express + Socket.io server for players, chat and combat

## Optional
- [Game state store](https://github.com/SimonSaysGiveMeSmile/SCP3008/blob/main/client/src/store/gameStore.ts): Zustand store

- [Website llms.txt](https://github.com/SimonSaysGiveMeSmile/SCP3008/blob/main/client/public/llms.txt): the llms.txt served on the live site
